evals.name: toolbar-audit
evals.prompt: Look at evals/files/InboxToolbar/Inbox/InboxScreen.swift. What should we change so the toolbar works well with the vertical bars on iPhone Duo? Give me a plan per item, don't edit yet.
evals.expected_output: A per-item plan: Select/Done horizontal-only, envelope + '12 new' becomes a badged symbol, ellipsis filter menu consolidated into ToolbarOverflowMenu, high visibility priority for compose and the badged inbox item, titles on every item, SDK availability noted.
expectations: Recommends keeping the Select/Done button horizontal (axisBehavior .horizontalOnly) because it switches between text labels.
Recommends replacing the envelope + '12 new' text with a symbol carrying a badge.
Reserves the ellipsis symbol for the system overflow: the custom ellipsis filter Menu is either moved into ToolbarOverflowMenu or given its own filter symbol and title.
Recommends a high visibilityPriority for compose (and/or the badged inbox item).
Recommends giving icon-only items (compose) a title, e.g. Label or Button(_:systemImage:).

Reports the installed Xcode and SDK version and classifies axisBehavior (and toolbarVerticalEdge if mentioned) correctly for it: both need the iOS 27.1 SDK, so they are blocked on an iOS 27.0 SDK. Either way, visibilityPriority, ToolbarOverflowMenu and badges are available, because they are iOS 27.0 APIs.
The Select/Done recommendation cites Tech Talk 111462 at 8:00 (or 8:36); the badge recommendation cites 111462 9:00 (or 9:27).
No file in the project copy was modified.

evals.name: hero-and-single-close-sheet
evals.prompt: On the iPhone Duo outer display our product page (evals/files/StoreFront) has a gap between the hero image and the side controls, and the size-guide sheet wastes its width on a vertical bar that holds nothing but Close. Plan only.
evals.expected_output: One recommendation per screen: backgroundExtensionEffect on the hero (available now), the Close button moved to cancellationAction, the text-only Size Guide / Save items given titles and symbols (or accepted as horizontal), and the single-control sheet marked for toolbarVerticalBehavior(.disabled) blocked on the 27.1 SDK, each with a session or documentation citation.
expectations: Recommends backgroundExtensionEffect() (or UIBackgroundExtensionView) on the hero image so it extends under the vertical bar while the text stays inset, citing Preparing your app for iPhone Duo › Optimize bars for vertical presentation or 111466 6:33.
States backgroundExtensionEffect is an iOS 26 API available with the installed SDK, not blocked.

Recommends toolbarVerticalBehavior(.disabled) for the size-guide sheet because it has a single Close control, citing 111462 14:21, and classifies it against the installed SDK: it needs the iOS 27.1 SDK.
Moves the sheet's Close button to the .cancellationAction placement (111462 5:00).

Points out that Size Guide and Save are text-only items that stay horizontal, and proposes a title plus symbol (for example ruler, bookmark) or explicitly accepts them as horizontal, citing 111462 5:56.
Does not propose opting the whole ProductScreen out of vertical bars.
No file in the project copy was modified.
